name: claudebridge
description: Coordinate Claude and Codex naturally: multiple projects, isolated parallel tasks, persistent messages and recovery.
long_description: ClaudeBridge connects Codex CLI to Claude Desktop through MCP. Includes a bundled Codex CLI, supports multiple local projects, durable SQLite state, safe Git worktrees, independent tasks and plain-language operation. One-time ChatGPT sign-in is still required.

tools.name: bridge_project
tools.description: Connect, list or switch local project folders.

tools.name: bridge_delegate
tools.description: Delegate parallel Codex coding or read-only reviews.

tools.name: bridge_context
tools.description: Read persisted agent messages and project history.
